## Install

1. Download **NameCards-….dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **NameCards** onto **Applications**.
3. The first time only: open NameCards from Applications. macOS will say it can't verify the app. Click
   **Done**, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to
   the NameCards message. Confirm with your password or Touch ID.

This is needed because the app isn't registered with Apple (that costs a yearly fee). The README on the
project's main page has more details.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
